text: {"lessons":["Selling parts of A and C after large gains locked in profits, but I should base future sales on my target allocation and plan, not the size of a paper gain alone.","My trades focused on A and C, so I should limit single-stock and sector concentration and diversify deliberately.","Account values rose overall, but a short record cannot show whether my trading decisions caused the gains; I should judge my process over time and avoid chasing recent performance."]}
